text:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xxs for prompt-router-v2. error-rate 12% -> paging oncall @mika :rotating_light:

mika: on it, checking metrics now

alex: seeing similar from canary cluster, requests timing out at model-proxy stage

chris: logs show kernel mismatch errors on several nodes: `inference: kernel_select failed: incompatible-kernel-id`

mika: ok killing the new endpoint route flag `ff.prompt_router_v2` for 100% of traffic now. running command:
```bash
redwoodctl feature disable ff.prompt_router_v2 --env=prod --scope=global
```

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: mika acknowledged the incident (INC-20294)

emily: rolling rollback on canary gateway just in case. running `deploy rollback prompt-gateway --to=stable-2026-03-15`

alex: after flip, 5xxs dropping. confirming with dashboards... looks like error-rate down to 0.9% at edge

mika: good. leaving flag disabled while we triage. creating bridge -> https://meet.redwood.com/bridges/INC-20294

chris: root cause likely a kernel selection change in the experimental runtime that wasn't backward compatible with quantized checkpoints. reproducing locally with `--kernel-version=nightly-42`

jess: tagging product and cs: @cs-team please prepare a quick customer note. impact window ~ 10m start 3945672100

cs-team: on it. drafting message: "We experienced increased error rates for prompts routed to an experimental endpoint between 3945672100 and 3945672300. Traffic routed back to stable; features disabled. We're investigating and will follow up."

mika: handing off to chris for root-cause and remediation plan. I'm going offline in 10m; call me back if it spikes again.

chris: taking over. immediate plan: 1) disable ff permanently for rollout 2) add compatibility test for kernel selection 3) patch runtime to guard against unsupported kernel id. will open a PR and link here.

alex: telemetry note: some customers saw increased latency before errors. recommend reviewing tail latency dashboards for top 5 tenants.

emily: I'll cut a hotfix rollback for the gateway release and pin to stable kernels across the pool.

mika: thanks team. incident status -> mitigated, customer impact: partial (some requests failed), total duration ~3m active spike, now routed to stable. I'll update incident record and close after RCA stub. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-20294 status changed to "Mitigated" by mika at 3945672345

chris: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789 - adds kernel compatibility check and test. tagging for review.

jess: once PR merges, let's run canary with `ff.prompt_router_v2=canary-sliced` and a small traffic ramp with strict SLO alerting.

cs-team: posted customer note to status.redwood.com and queued emails for known affected accounts.

mika: handing to next oncall @alex for overnight monitoring. I'll brief briefly in the bridge.

alex: acknowledged handoff. watching dashboards for 2 hours, will escalate if any regression.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: alex is now on-call (escalation) for INC-20294

incident-bot: Closing note: follow-up RCA and timeline to be added to INC-20294 ticket.
